response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM order_counts) SELECT timespan, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan
